title: AI Life Scenario Submission Data Contract
description: JSON Schema contract for a scenario pull-request submission. Validated by tools/scenario_validator.py and the Go pipeline orchestrator.

asset_code.description: Unique scenario identifier from the Asset Code registry (e.g. SCEN-006)

namespace.description: Which scenario namespace this submission belongs to

title.description: Short human-readable title (appended to namespace path)

date_proposed.description: ISO-8601 date the scenario was proposed (UTC)

contributor.description: GitHub handle or name of the proposing contributor

participants.description: At least two participants — AI systems and/or humans

type.description: Whether this participant is an AI system or a human

model_provider.description: For AI systems: the model provider page name (e.g. 'Anthropic', 'OpenAI')

enum: AI as a Manager (AI-Led Decision Making)
AI as an Autonomous Agent (AI Independence)
role.description: Role from the Human-AI Relationships Glossary or human role descriptor

interaction_log.description: URL or inline log of the actual interaction (optional for seed examples)

risk_profile.description: Inherited risk tier from the highest-risk participant role

applicable_policies.description: List of policy page references (e.g. 'AI Governance/Policies/AI Use Case Documentation Policy')

bias_flags.description: Optional list of bias or sensitivity flags

high_risk_review_required.description: Automatically true when risk_profile is High or Critical

why_ai_life.description: Explanation of what this scenario reveals about AI's experience or condition

references.description: List of related page references or external URLs
